messages:
Rina: Hey team, launch week assets needed: modular hero, three benchmark micro-tiles (latency vs cost), small routing infographic for SDR handoff, and a single-slide webinar cover. Goal: consistent look for paid/social/email. Due: Fri EOD.
Mira: Copy that. Will the benchmark tiles need sparklines or bar comparisons?
Rina: Sparklines for cost trend, bars for p50 latency. Metrics: Hosted p50=90ms cost=$0.0026, Dedicated p50=62ms cost=$0.00155, Private p50=74ms cost=$0.00195. Add note: "Dedicated most cost-efficient at scale."
Jon: Routing rules: score >= 60 -> immediate SDR + slack alert (#sdr-live); below -> 7-day digest nurture. Use compact legend and color-coded paths.
Priya: Brand constraints: new color tokens (navy, coral, moss), use Inter, H1 46 semibold. Icons: flat two-tone. Keep each tile to max 3 data points + 1 line insight. Also need AA contrast.
Mira: Deliverables: Figma file with pages for hero/tiles/routing, PNG exports 1200x628 (social), 1600x900 (email hero), 1920x1080 (webinar). Include separate localized layers for en-US and en-GB.
Rina: Legal: avoid absolutes like "cheapest". @Priya can you add a footnote: "Based on internal Redwood tests, June 2025"?
Priya: Yep. Will draft legal-friendly language and check copy by Thu. Also will confirm any trademarked terms.
Mira: Small UX Q: place for CTA microcopy? Button text suggestions?
Jon: Hero CTA: "Register for benchmark webinar". Tile small link: "Read full benchmark". Include UTM slot: utm_campaign=launch_q3&utm_source=social.
design-bot: Asset checklist added: [Figma master, PNG 1200x628, PNG 1600x900, PNG 1920x1080, SVG icons, localizable text layers, export manifest].
Mira: I'll post first drafts Wed evening and a refined pass Thu noon. Please comment in Figma so Slack stays tidy.
Rina: Thanks — once drafts up I'll do a copy pass and Priya will sign off legal/brand.
Priya: Adding accessibility checklist and footnote copy now.
Mira: Uploading draft: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/Launch-Visuals-Module — comments enabled.
Jon: I'll review routing visual and ensure it's compact for email.
Rina: Appreciate it. Please flag any blockers early. :sparkles:
